channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: You can buy MediaAnalyzer credit with crypto now
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: MediaAnalyzer now sells prepaid credit for crypto. Nine coins, face value, and the three guards that stop a webhook crediting the same payment twice.

item.title: OpenEmoji and OpenIcon: 3,963 emoji, 370 icons, and your terminal gets them too
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Two open specs and a complete set for each: every standard emoji drawn as one family with install packs for 22 networks, and UI icons that know what to draw in a terminal. Built into HQTUI.

item.title: TronBrowser v3.15.0: agents can finally fill in a real form
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Upload, custom dropdowns, stable refs and a few other fixes that let tron automate complete a real job application, plus jobhunt in cli-tools.

item.title: $20 a smoke, and the weekly Cigar Underground Herf
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: We put Cigar Underground online two days ago with the Chovy Premium Blend at $200 a cigar. Then we looked at the waitlist. It had two names on it, and I know both of them.

item.title: NIGHTCELL 7 v0.4.0: When the Ravens Lied remade, and a shuffle across both albums
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Þrøngva's second album is now full songs made in Suno, and the soundtrack shuffles all 32 tracks across both albums.

item.title: NIGHTCELL 7: When the Ravens Lied, a second Þrøngva album made in code
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Twelve new Viking metal and hip-hop tracks for NIGHTCELL 7, every note synthesised from a lyric sheet by a numpy script.

item.title: NIGHTCELL 7 v0.3.0: a soundtrack, and a first run that teaches you
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: NIGHTCELL 7 v0.3.0 adds a 20-track album by Þrøngva, a first-run briefing and a coach that teaches each control when you do it.

item.title: Cigar Underground: a cigar brand and a drop-ship store, built in a day
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Hand rolled cigars and leaf spliffs from Dave's Workshop, and a live shop with magic-link accounts and CoinPay crypto checkout, shipped in one day by one person and a fleet of agents.

item.title: readm3 0.6.0: paste Markdown behind a private link, no account
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: readm3.com can now hand out a private link for a Markdown document without anyone signing in. Paste the file, pick how long the link lives, and you get https://readm3.com/p/<token>. Anyone with the…

item.title: CoinPay finances now does the books: reports, a review queue, and the pack your CPA asked…
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: CoinPay finances now syncs your bank and card accounts every 30 minutes, keeps every raw provider response, produces exact monthly and quarterly reports, keeps your bank statements beside them, auto-categorises every transaction for tax with a review queue, emails the pack to your accountant, and sends a weekly digest on the days you choose.
